config.enabled: Turn srmd on for this workspace: load the notes of its folder, show the Flashcards view and Explorer badges, and watch for changes. Off by default, so other projects are never searched. The Turn On and Turn Off commands and the status bar item set it in the workspace settings; set it in your user settings to turn srmd on everywhere.
config.rollover: Local time when the review day starts (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).
config.inactive.front: Show inactive clozes on the front of a card.
config.inactive.back: Show inactive clozes on the back of a card.
config.queueOrder: Order in which review queues are served: cards seen earlier today and due again (intraday), cards due from earlier days (interday), and new cards. List each queue once.
config.extensions.foamPlaceholders: Read notes written for Foam: hide block anchors (^id), and show wiki links and embeds as text.
config.format.wrap: How Format Document breaks the lines of a note's paragraphs.
config.format.wrap.preserve: Keep the line breaks as written.
config.format.wrap.always: Wrap lines at the line width.
config.format.wrap.never: Put each paragraph on one line.
config.format.lineWidth: The line width paragraphs wrap at, list markers and quote prefixes included, when lines wrap.
config.format.numbering: How Format Document numbers the items of ordered lists.
config.format.numbering.increment: Count up from the first item's number: 1. 2. 3.
config.format.bullet: The bullet Format Document writes for the items of unordered lists. A list directly after another gets a different bullet, which keeps them apart.
config.format.tableDelimiters: How Format Document writes the delimiter row of a table.
config.format.emphasis: The delimiters Format Document writes around emphasis (italics).
config.format.emphasis.underscore: Underscores: _emphasis_, where they work, which is not within a word.
config.format.strong: The delimiters Format Document writes around strong emphasis (bold).
config.format.strong.underscore: Underscores: __strong__, where they work, which is not within a word.
